reviewNotes: HOLD. Current JPY850/month pricing, Japan-address identity requirements, payment restrictions and overseas voice/SMS behavior are now first-party supported. Keep as resident-gated negative/conditional knowledge; no publication change.

events.outcome: Current provider evidence confirms JPY850/month 2GB voice pricing, Japan-address/identity/payment gating, and overseas voice/SMS availability for voice SIM/eSIM.

data.acquisitionSummary: Giga Plan voice service currently starts at JPY850/month for 2GB. Voice/SMS service requires a Japanese residential address and a matching accepted identity document; there is no supported no-Japan-address signup path.

keep.action: Maintain the 2GB voice subscription at JPY850/month. No verified idle/PAYG retention mode exists for this route.

data.chinaActivation: A new voice/SMS contract requires a Japanese current address, Japanese contact number and compatible monthly-settlement credit card, so direct nonresident activation from mainland China is not supported.
data.kyc: Online voice/SMS signup requires identity verification. Current accepted online documents include residence cards and other Japan-issued identity documents; a Japanese current address matching the identity document is required.
data.payment: Credit card only, in the individual subscriber's own name. IIJmio warns that overseas-issued cards may not work.
data.roamingSms: Voice SIM and voice eSIM support overseas voice and SMS; overseas data is not available. Exact app-specific OTP success is unverified.
data.holdReason: The route is current and cheap by Japanese subscription standards, but new voice/SMS signup requires a Japanese current address and resident-compatible identity/payment path; it is not a general nonresident acquisition route.
guideSteps: Use JPY850/month as the current 2GB voice floor.
Do not claim passport-only or no-Japan-address signup.
Treat overseas voice/SMS support as network capability, not proof of mainland-China OTP reliability.
